name: labs/lachlangunn__oic
title: OIC Arduino DAQ / meter
intro: OIC Arduino DAQ / meter, adapted from lachlangunn/oic. It reads `voltage2`; sets `voltage0` and `voltage1`. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/lachlangunn__oic --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/lachlangunn__oic --backend fake --mcp
